author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_byteview_name_collision.rs::user_spec_fn_named_like_a_generated_byteview_fn_still_certifies_l3 demonstrates the divergence: two byte-identical String-scanning spec fns (the proven #126 spec_scan/spec_line_start shape) certify DIFFERENTLY by NAME. Control 'scan_x' -> L3; rename to 'is_digit' (a name in the fixed callee_takes_string_byteview set parse_le/parse_be/all_digits/is_digit/occurs_at/contains_sub/count_sep/sep_free) -> L0. The &String self-call arg is misrouted to .data@ (Seq<u8>) against the &TString param the lowered signature declares (E0308). Root cause: callee_takes_string_byteview keys the byte-view rewrite on callee NAME, not the &String param SHAPE. Authority: .design/basis/07-strings.md REQ-4 (String-scanning spec fn MUST lower + certify; the set is SHAPE-derived). Reproduced directly: forge check on /tmp fixtures, is_digit L0 vs scan_x L3, isolated by rename-only. Fix is generator's (owning crate thermite-lower).
